newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Pennzoil soars.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Pennzoil soars.

text.p: Pennzoil Co shares rocketed higher before Monday's market opening, boosted by news that Union Pacific Resources Group Inc was again making it a takeover target.
Pennzoil was trading at 85, up from a Friday New York Stock Exchange close of 59-5/8. Union Pacific was not trading.
"It's amazing," said a trader who reported one 10,000-share trade at 85. "It's trading liquidly there."
Union Pacific said it was offering a two-step cash-and-stock transaction for Pennzoil valued at about $6.4 billion. Pennzoil has rebuffed previous bids by Union Pacific.
In another merger-related development, Compaq Computer Co agreed to acquire Tandem Computers Inc for $3 billion in stock.
Tandem was up sharply at 21 from a Friday close of 15 and Compaq was down, at 104 from a 106-7/8 close on Friday, traders said.
Healthdyne Technologies Inc was at 16-1/4 from a Friday close of 15-1/2 after Invacare Corp extended its tender offer for Healthdyne to Aug 1.
In other active shares, APL Ltd was trading at 29-1/16 from a close of 30-3/4. Traders said there was no apparent news moving the shares.
Among tobacco stocks, Philip Morris Cos Inc, a Dow industrials component, was trading at 45-1/8, down from a Friday close of 45-5/8.
